# Ting 0.7.2
## Fix
- Selecta no longer consumes ordinary keys during AppKit's key-equivalent handling. Arrow keys and Return now reach the menu navigation added in 0.7.1. Command shortcuts such as Command-Q remain blocked while the menu is open.
## Upgrade
Choose **Check for Updates…** in Ting. Settings, bindings, micro-apps and permissions are preserved. Requires macOS 14 or later; the signed, notarized and stapled universal app supports Apple Silicon and Intel.
